settings/updateChannel.title: Update channel
settings/updateChannel.body: Stable receives finished releases. Release candidate receives pre-release builds for testing and is only available to power users. Dev builds never check for updates.

settings/autoCheckUpdates.title: Check on launch
settings/autoCheckUpdates.body: When enabled, Akira checks GitHub for a newer build on startup (at most once a day) and shows a prompt if one is available. Disable to only check manually.

settings/checkForUpdates.title: Check for updates
settings/checkForUpdates.body: Query GitHub now for the latest build on your selected channel and report whether an update is available.
